description: This file defines an enumeration 'LoanTermVariationType' representing different types of loan term variations in the FinAcer system. It includes constants for various variation types, methods for mapping integer values to enum instances, and predicate methods to check specific variation types.

classes.name: LoanTermVariationType
classes.description: An enum representing different types of loan term variations with associated integer values and string codes. Provides utility methods for mapping and checking variation types.

methods.name: getValue
methods.description: Returns the integer value associated with the variation type.

methods.name: getCode
methods.description: Returns the string code associated with the variation type.

methods.name: fromInt
methods.description: Static method that maps an integer to the corresponding LoanTermVariationType enum, defaulting to INVALID if no match.

methods.name: isEMIAmountVariation
methods.description: Checks if the variation type is EMI_AMOUNT.

methods.name: isInterestRateVariation
methods.description: Checks if the variation type is INTEREST_RATE.

methods.name: isInterestPauseVariation
methods.description: Checks if the variation type is INTEREST_PAUSE.

methods.name: isPrincipalAmountVariation
methods.description: Checks if the variation type is PRINCIPAL_AMOUNT.

methods.name: isDueDateVariation
methods.description: Checks if the variation type is DUE_DATE.

methods.name: isInsertInstallment
methods.description: Checks if the variation type is INSERT_INSTALLMENT.

methods.name: isDeleteInstallment
methods.description: Checks if the variation type is DELETE_INSTALLMENT.

methods.name: isGraceOnInterest
methods.description: Checks if the variation type is GRACE_ON_INTEREST.

methods.name: isGraceOnPrincipal
methods.description: Checks if the variation type is GRACE_ON_PRINCIPAL.

methods.name: isExtendReparationPeriod
methods.description: Checks if the variation type is EXTEND_REPAYMENT_PERIOD.

methods.name: isInterestRateFromInstallment
methods.description: Checks if the variation type is INTEREST_RATE_FROM_INSTALLMENT.
